title: 最高人民法院指导性案例（指导案例1号 至 指导性案例279号）

原始链接.note: the court.gov.cn page the record was read from; 指导案例45号 has no such page, so its record names the court-run mirror it was read from instead

案号.note: case number of the effective judgment, read out of 裁判结果; empty when the page names none

案件名称.note: the published title, 指导性案例NNN号 prefix included; line wraps inside the title are joined

法院.note: a guiding-case page names no single adjudicating court; the courts it does mention are in the JSON field courts_mentioned

案件类型.note: the first term of 关键词 (民事 / 刑事 / 行政 / 执行 / …)

案件类型编码.note: the code extract.rs documents for that 案件类型; empty when the group has no code

来源.note: 最高人民法院指导性案例

审理程序.note: a guiding case spans instances, so no single procedure applies

裁判日期.note: the SPC publishes a 发布日期 for a guiding case, not a judgment date

公开日期.note: the date shown on the listing page

当事人.note: the publisher anonymises the parties itself (某); no party list is published

案由.note: a guiding case publishes no 案由 label, and cutting a phrase out of the case name would invent one; the 关键词 terms are the closest published thing

法律依据.note: the page's 相关法条 section

全文.note: title, 发布 note and every published section, plain text, markup removed, nothing reworded

notes: 指导案例45号 is announced by 第10批 (指导案例45-52号) but the site's 指导案例 listing publishes no page for it, and no xiangqing page exists for it; its record is taken verbatim from the 洛阳中院 mirror named in the crawler's SUPPLEMENTS, so the dataset holds 279 of 1-279.
24 cases publish no 裁判结果 section, so 案号 is empty for them.
7 执行 cases publish 执行实施要点 where the others publish 裁判要点.
法院, 所属地区, 审理程序, 当事人 and 案由 are left empty: a guiding-case page publishes none of them as a field. Nothing is inferred into a filterable column.

batch attribution covers 79 of the 279 cases: 14 of the 15 notices in this listing name case-number ranges (the 第1批 notice names its cases by title only, and the 第2批 notice is not in this listing); batches after 第16批 were published here without a notice.
全文 is plain text, so a search over it needs index_with_full_text = true; at 780 kB of text that costs nothing.

redistribution.basis: official judicial document of the Supreme People's Court, published for courts to refer to in similar cases; the publisher anonymises the parties itself, so a record names no private individual
redistribution.cite: cite the 指导案例 number and the source_url stored with every record
